title: 公开 PS4 homebrew：真实 CPU/HLE 与图形呈现验证
summary: 在本机 Windows 上运行官方 shadPS4 v0.19.0，成功执行 OpenOrbis hello_world，并显示 graphics 样例的蓝色 Mandelbrot 分形。

versions.sample: OpenOrbis-PS4-Toolchain v0.5.3, official samples-elf-llvm-18.zip: hello_world + graphics

environment.os: Windows 11 家庭版 中文版 (64 bit)
environment.cpu: Intel Core i9-13980HX, 24 physical cores / 32 logical cores
environment.system_modules: None: portable user/sys_modules contains zero files

checks.name: 官方 Windows 发布包 SHA-256
CLI --version
checks.evidence: The flag is not implemented in this release. Version/commit were obtained from actual guest startup logs instead.

checks.name: OpenOrbis hello_world：真实 guest 代码与 HLE
checks.evidence: results/hello-converted-stdout.txt includes Game:Main / Hello world! Waiting 2 seconds! / Done. Infinitely looping...; GPU.null_gpu=true

checks.name: OpenOrbis graphics：VideoOut + Vulkan 实际呈现
checks.evidence: results/graphics-stdout.txt includes Creating a scene / sceVideoOutOpen / RegisterBuffers (1920x1080) / Entering draw loop...; target-window screenshot shows the blue Mandelbrot fractal; GPU.null_gpu=false

checks.name: 仓库内复现脚本
checks.evidence: run_public_example.py was run with --sample hello_world --seconds 5 --driver-select *nv*, observing guest output, and --sample graphics --seconds 6 --driver-select *nv*.

checks.name: 初次未筛选驱动的 Vulkan 启动
checks.evidence: results/diagnostic-vulkan-failure-stdout.txt: vkCreateDevice ErrorOutOfHostMemory; stderr also reports Mesa D3D12 errors. Later run with the process-local NVIDIA driver filter succeeded; root cause was not independently isolated.

limit: 已验证的范围是公开 homebrew 的 guest CPU 执行、部分 HLE、帧缓冲注册及 Vulkan 呈现。Mandelbrot 的像素由样例 CPU 代码计算，不证明 GCN 着色器重编译、3D 游戏性能或商业 PS4 游戏兼容性。没有进行 PS4 主机实测，也没有下载 Sony 系统模块或商业游戏。
output: 真实模拟器窗口显示 1920×1080 CPU 生成的蓝色 Mandelbrot 分形；窗口截图为 1282×752。样例按照源码无限循环，由验证流程在观察后停止。

media.caption: 本机 Windows：shadPS4 v0.19.0 实际运行 OpenOrbis v0.5.3 graphics。蓝色 Mandelbrot 分形由 guest CPU 写入帧缓冲，经 sceVideoOut 和 Vulkan 呈现；仅截取模拟器目标窗口。
